DIAGNOSIS READY: De Quervain's Tenosynovitis (with possible post-traumatic inflammatory component).

The patient's history of a fall six months ago, combined with pain radiating from the thumb to the elbow and worsening with infant holding, strongly suggests tendinopathy of the first dorsal compartment.
